title: A Systematic Comparison of Search Space Complexity and Efficiency for Time-Synchronous End-to-End ASR Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.31259v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Search is a central component of Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems and has been deeply investigated for classical ASR modeling based on Hidden Markov Models (HMMs). However, in work on current sequence-to-sequence ASR architectures it is often simplified to a small fixed-size beam search without external Language Model (LM). In this work, we present a comparative analysis of search space complexity and efficiency for Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) and neural transducer models under different pruning strategies and LM configurations. We show that these end-to-end (E2E) models work with a small search space most of the time but exhibit large temporary peaks in hypothesis count during periods of uncertainty. translated_title: 时间同步端到端语音识别模型搜索空间复杂度与效率的系统性比较
translated_abstract: 搜索是自动语音识别（ASR）系统的核心组成部分，在基于隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）的经典ASR建模中已被深入研究。然而，在当前序列到序列ASR架构的研究中，搜索通常被简化为不带外部语言模型（LM）的小型固定大小束搜索。在这项工作中，我们对连接主义时间分类（CTC）和神经转换器模型在不同剪枝策略和语言模型配置下的搜索空间复杂度和效率进行了比较分析。我们表明，这些端到端（E2E）模型大部分时间在较小的搜索空间内工作，但在不确定性较高的时段会出现假设数量的大幅临时峰值。基于得分的剪枝能够根据模型不确定性动态调整搜索，从而显著降低实时率（RTF）。我们的结果凸显了低固定大小束剪枝搜索的局限性……
tldr: 该论文系统比较了CTC和神经转换器等时间同步端到端语音识别模型在不同剪枝策略和语言模型配置下的搜索空间复杂度与效率，发现端到端模型多数时候搜索空间较小但会在不确定时出现假设数量峰值，而基于得分的动态剪枝可适应模型不确定性并显著降低实时率。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically compares the search space complexity and efficiency of time-synchronous E2E ASR models (CTC and neural transducers) under various pruning strategies and LM configurations, showing that score-based pruning dynamically adapts to model uncertainty and significantly reduces the real-time factor compared to low fixed-size beam pruning.
